title: daily care schedule: a shortlist that makes sense
description: A shortlist of daily care schedule options that make sense: the smallest version to start, when to run it, and a weekly review as a check.
answer: Three people in the family chat ask about daily care schedule, and none of the answers match. PetGo keeps daily care schedule on-device, so it stays readable with no data plan and no account.

sections.p: One line per member: status, date, and the single thing that needs action.
Fill it at dinner, or when the family chat is already busy.
Once a week, look at the part that breaks most often and shrink the target instead of adding willpower.

table.caption: A working frame for daily care schedule

list: Pick one fixed time, not “whenever there is room”.
Open PetGo when that time arrives, not later tonight.
Note one blocker, not a long excuse.
Back up before you switch phones.
faqs: Can I open daily care schedule offline?
Yes. PetGo keeps everything on-device, so no data plan is needed.
Do I need an account first?
No. Start without login; export a backup from time to time.
With the shortest piece. Add scope only after two steady weeks.
What if I miss a few days?
Do not wipe history. Resume from the last entry and note one blocker.
